core_obligations: Verify (1): i_f = f_big o i_Y by the equality i_f^{-1} = i_T^{-1} o f_big^{-1} read off the functor descriptions.
Part (2): invoke the properties-of-spaces functoriality lemma for the morphism of sites and the pushforward formula F(U x_X Y/Y).
Part (3): check the commutative square by comparing defining functors (inclusions for pi, base change for the f-morphisms), giving f_small o pi_Y = pi_X o f_big.
Part (4): precompose (3) with i_Y to get f_small = pi_X o f_big o i_Y = pi_X o i_f.
proof_roadmap: Read the three relations off the functor descriptions; the morphism-of-sites input for (2) is the functoriality lemma; (4) is (3) precomposed with i_Y.
difficulty_reason: Four coordinate relations between six morphisms of sites; each part is short but the bookkeeping must be exact and (3) is a genuine comparison of defining functors.
